# Database connection parameters
# Note: Run the connection in the terminal first:
# psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U dfstechbi -d db_fraud
from urllib.parse import quote_plus
from sqlalchemy import text

DB_CONFIG = {
    'host': '10.205.161.118',
    'port': '5432',
    'database': 'db_fraud',
    'user': 'dfstechbi',
    'password': 'DfsTeChB1@923'  # You'll enter this when prompted
}

# Prompt for password
from getpass import getpass
DB_CONFIG['password'] = quote_plus(getpass('Enter database password: '))

# Create SQLAlchemy engine
connection_string = f"postgresql://{DB_CONFIG['user']}:{DB_CONFIG['password']}@{DB_CONFIG['host']}:{DB_CONFIG['port']}/{DB_CONFIG['database']}"
engine = create_engine(connection_string)

# Test connection
try:
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        result = conn.execute(text("SELECT version();"))
        print("✅ Database connection successful!")
        print(f"PostgreSQL version: {result.fetchone()[0].split(',')[0]}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"❌ Connection failed: {e}")

Fraud Stats¶

fraud cases per day over time¶

In [56]:
# Plot number of fraud cases per day over time with mean line and show day of week name
# Calculate number of fraud cases per day
cases_per_day = df.groupby(df['created_datetime'].dt.date).size()
cases_per_day_df = cases_per_day.to_frame(name='cases')
cases_per_day_df['day_of_week'] = cases_per_day_df.index.map(lambda d: d.strftime('%A'))

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))
plt.plot(cases_per_day_df.index, cases_per_day_df['cases'], label='Daily Cases')
mean_cases = cases_per_day_df['cases'].mean()
plt.axhline(mean_cases, color='red', linestyle='--', label=f'Mean ({mean_cases:.2f})')

# Annotate day of week for each tick (show every 7th for readability)
xticks = cases_per_day_df.index[::7]
xticklabels = [f"{d.strftime('%b %d')} ({d.strftime('%A')})" for d in xticks]
plt.xticks(xticks, xticklabels, rotation=45, ha='right')

plt.title('Number of Fraud Cases Over Time with Mean and Day of Week')
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Number of Cases')
plt.xlim(cases_per_day_df.index.min(), cases_per_day_df.index.max())
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

Weekday vs Weekend Fraud Cases Over Time¶

In [57]:
# Show weekday vs weekend count of cases over time
cases_per_day_df['is_weekend'] = cases_per_day_df['day_of_week'].isin(['Saturday', 'Sunday'])
weekday_cases = cases_per_day_df[~cases_per_day_df['is_weekend']]['cases']
weekend_cases = cases_per_day_df[cases_per_day_df['is_weekend']]['cases']

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))
plt.plot(weekday_cases.index, weekday_cases.values, label='Weekday Cases', color='blue')
plt.plot(weekend_cases.index, weekend_cases.values, label='Weekend Cases', color='orange')
plt.title('Weekday vs Weekend Fraud Cases Over Time')

plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

fraud_msisdn_counts.index = fraud_msisdn_counts.index.str[:6]

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
fraud_msisdn_counts.plot(kind='bar', color='coral')
plt.title('Top 10 Fraud MSISDNs by Number of Cases')
plt.xlabel('Fraud MSISDN (First 6 Letters)')
plt.ylabel('Number of Cases')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
